Free Food.description: Food or drinks provided to attendees for free.
Free Food.rules: Tag only if the email indicates attendees receive food/drink at no cost. Do NOT tag if the email is about donating/collecting food, potlucks where you bring food, or meeting at a restaurant without saying it's covered.
examples_should_tag: We’re ordering Han Fusion for everyone.
examples_should_not_tag: We are collecting non-perishable food items (donations).

Performance.description: Live artistic or cultural performance (music, theater, dance, comedy, spoken word).
Performance.rules: Tag when the event is framed as a show/performance. Do NOT tag film/video viewings (use Screening).
examples_should_tag: Dance show at Top of the Hop.
A cappella showcase at the Hop.

Lecture/Speaker.rules: Tag when the email is mainly about a speaker/panel/talk. If it’s hands-on skill building, use Workshop instead.
examples_should_tag: Guest speaker on climate policy followed by Q&A.

Giveaway/Compensation.description: Attendees may receive gift cards, prizes, raffles, swag, stipends, or payment.
Giveaway/Compensation.rules: Tag only if compensation/prizes/swag is offered to attendees/participants.

Screening.description: Watching a film/documentary/episode/video is the main activity.
Screening.rules: Tag when the email is primarily about viewing a movie/video content.
examples_should_tag: Film screening at Loew followed by discussion.

Mixer.description: Socializing/networking/meeting people is the main purpose.
Mixer.rules: Tag when the email emphasizes mingling/networking rather than a structured talk or hands-on activity.

Workshop.rules: Tag if the email indicates interactive practice/building (often includes 'bring your laptop' or 'hands-on').

Philanthropy.description: Fundraising, donations, volunteering/service, or proceeds supporting a cause.
Philanthropy.rules: Tag only if charity/fundraising/service is explicitly stated. Greek events count only when explicitly described as philanthropy/fundraising/service (not just a party).
examples_should_tag: Partnering to raise funds for hurricane relief.
Collecting donations for LISTEN Community Services Food Pantry.
examples_should_not_tag: Social event hosted by a fraternity (no cause/donations mentioned).

21+.rules: Tag only if the email explicitly says 21+ / must be 21 / 21 and over / valid ID required for age restriction.

Recurring Meetings.description: Regular club/group meetings that happen repeatedly (weekly/biweekly/ongoing).
Recurring Meetings.rules: Tag only if the email indicates a repeating schedule or ongoing club meetings (GBM counts).
examples_should_not_tag: One-time event with a single date.

Off-campus.description: Event is off Dartmouth’s main campus OR at a remote Dartmouth/outdoor location (e.g., Dartmouth Skiway, O-Farm, DOC trips/cabins).
Off-campus.rules: Tag only if the location/destination indicates leaving main campus OR names an off-campus place OR names a remote Dartmouth/outdoor location. Transportation words alone (shuttle/carpool) are not enough without a destination.
examples_should_tag: Shuttle leaving campus to Dartmouth Skiway.
examples_should_not_tag: Returning to campus mentioned but no destination.
